meta.cookidoodescription:
A world of Thermomix® recipes -  Cookidoo® brings you delicious food all over the world.
With thousands of recipes and ideas, you'll find mouth-watering inspiration every time you log in.

cms.title: Cookidoo® – the official Thermomix® recipe platform

message.body: Still haven’t found what you’re looking for? Try to use filters or find inspiration on the Explore page.
message.header: You have reached the limit of 1000 results.

description.includedAccessory: Filters recipes you are able to cook using your owned accessories.
description.includedAccessoryEmpty: We use your owned accessories to show recipes you can cook.
description.mydevices: Devices you own are selected by default.

button.only: Show only recipes using the active accessory

subheader.include: Select the accessories you want to include in your search among other recipes. Unchecked accessories are excluded from search results.
subheader.noselection: You will see recipes that do not require additional accessories.
subheader.only: Show only recipes using the active accessory

label.ingredients: You can use a "-" while typing ingredients to exclude certain ingredients e.g. -salt.
label.nosearchfilters: There are no filters available for your current selection. Please alter your search term.

subheader.3stars: You will see recipes with 3 or more stars.
subheader.4stars: You will see recipes with 4 or more stars.
subheader.5stars: You will see recipes with 5 stars only.
subheader.noselection: Select star to see recipes with that amount of stars or more.

portions.selection_one: You will see recipes with {counter} portion only.
portions.selection_other: You will see recipes with {counter} portions only.
portions.selection_zero: You will see recipes with {counter} portions only.
portions.tooltip: The activated portion filter excludes all other serving sizes like pieces, slices, bottles, and more.

tooltip.tags:
To exclude certain tags from your search, type "-" and then the tag name, e.g. "-difficult". 
As not all recipes are tagged, excluding a certain one will reduce the number of results rather than show the opposite.

subheadline.includedAccessory: Show results for accessories you own

suggestion.includedAccessory: By default: matched to your linked accessories
suggestion.ownedDevices: By default: matched to your devices
